thread:
oncall-bot: :rotating_light: Pager - high error rate for /v1/generate in us-west-2 (alert: 5xx_rate > 4% for 5m). Incident channel opened: #incidents-3032104567
elaine: Acked. I'm oncall for this shift, joining bridge now.
connor: Jumping in — checking autoscaler and pods. Seeing OOM kills on runtime-gpu-1-*.
elaine: Noted. Rolling non-critical pools to free capacity, switching traffic to replicas in us-east-1 as temporary fallback.
connor: Log snippet from node-3: ```kernel: Out of memory: Kill process 4321 (inference_runner) score 985 or sacrifice child
Oct 12 02:14:03 node-3 inference_runner[4321]: ERROR: Allocation failed for 1.2GiB tensor: CUDA out of memory
```
elaine: Looks like a batch size spike + one heavy request that pegged kv cache. Any recent rollout?
connor: No model rollout. Seeing a burst of long-sequence requests from a single API key: key=acct-prod-42, ~800 requests in 2m.
samir: Tagging customer-impact: cc @product-ops - any visible user errors?
product-ops: Checking telemetry — spike correlates with a single workspace using iterative eval jobs. Some requests have seq_len ~8192; most infra tuned for 2048 average.
elaine: Mitigation plan: 1) throttle offending API key at edge, 2) increase eviction on KV cache, 3) fail fast long-seq requests to a cheaper model variant. I'll apply throttles now.
connor: Applied iptables throttle for acct-prod-42 and increased cache eviction policy on runtime-gpu-1 pool. Pushing fallback routing to rdm-small-2048 for requests >4096 tokens.
elaine: Error rate dropping from 6.2% -> 1.1% over 6m. Traffic rebalanced to us-east-1 replicas.
sophie: Good work. For RCA and postmortem: can we capture timeline + decision notes? I'll schedule the writeup meeting.
product-ops: Customer impact: one enterprise customer reported degraded responses for ~9 minutes, and about 1.2k requests got 5xx. No billing anomalies detected. SLA threshold for 5xx_rate is 0.5% for this tier — we hit ~6% at peak.
legal: Any PII exposure? Looks like requests were opaque text blobs. No customer data leak reported.
samir: Action items proposal (assign owners):
- A1: Rate-limit smart throttling by workspace (connor) — due 2023-10-19
- A2: Improve KV cache eviction heuristics for long-sequence patterns (elaine) — due 2023-10-24
- A3: Add fallback routing rule for >4096 tokens (sophie) — due 2023-10-18
- A4: Postmortem writeup + timeline (sophie) — draft due 2023-10-16, review by peers 2023-10-18
- A5: Update docs on best-practice per-request sequence limits (product-ops) — due 2023-10-30
connor: I'll open PR for A1 and include tests simulating rate-burst.
elaine: For A2, I'll instrument per-session seq_len histograms and publish metric `inference.kv.evictions.by_seq_bucket`.
sophie: Scheduling postmortem meeting: Proposed 2023-10-17 16:00 UTC (30m). Inviting infra, runtime, product, security. Draft link: https://docs.redwood.com/postmortems/3032104567-draft (placeholder)
product-ops: I'll prepare the customer impact blurb and sample logs for support.
connor: Quick note for timeline section in writeup:
- 02:13:47 alert triggered
- 02:14:05 oncall joined bridge
- 02:16:12 throttle applied to acct-prod-42
- 02:18:30 fallback routing enabled
- 02:22:00 error rate below 1.5%
- 02:23:51 incident declared mitigated
elaine: Root cause (candidate): unmetered burst of long-sequence requests from a single workspace that exhausted GPU memory due to an uncommon eval harness pattern + conservative KV cache eviction settings.
sophie: For RCA drafting, can someone own the contributing factors and risk matrix? I nominate @connor for infra causes and @elaine for runtime/serving causes.
connor: Happy to own infra section.
elaine: I’ll own serving/runtime section and propose mitigation PRs.
samir: Peer review plan: Sophie will circulate draft, two peer reviewers required (one infra, one product). Sign-off needed from oncall lead and product-ops before closing.
product-ops: I'll review for customer impact accuracy.
legal: Please include a short blurb about data handling; I'll sign off if no data exposure.
sophie: Assigning reviewers: connor, product-ops, legal. Draft link will be posted by EOD.
elaine: Quick follow-up: should we add a runtime safety check to reject seq_len>8192 at edge? Might avoid similar incidents.
connor: +1 — also add an alert for sustained seq_len distribution shift.
samir: Noted. Adding that as A6: Alert for sustained long-seq distribution shift (pager if >2% requests >4096 for 5m) — owner: samir — due 2023-10-20
sophie: Closing notes: Great mitigation. Let's keep action items tracked in PM board and mark RCA draft milestone. I’ll ping everyone when the draft is ready. :thumbsup:
product-ops: Thanks team. I'll notify the affected customer with a brief incident summary after draft is ready.
connor: Leaving a small debugging snippet for the writeup: ```kubectl describe pod runtime-gpu-1-5
Containers:
  inference-runner:
    State: Terminated
    Reason: OOMKilled
    Last State: Running
    Exit Code: 137
```
elaine: last note: we should consider a short-term quota on eval jobs per workspace. Filing as A7 (product-ops) — due 2023-10-31
product-ops: Filed.
